## Notes

7,818 Steam titles with generative AI disclosures, about 7% of about 114,126; about 1.1% a year earlier; a little under 20% of 2025 releases; visual assets in about 60% of disclosures. Lower bound, voluntary disclosures, counted via Steam API.
